resources.string: Connection and how many requests wait for you. Nothing else is shown.

Find this desktop on this network

For when its address changed. The desktop must announce itself: PAL Settings › PAL Mobile › Let paired phones find this PC. Any address found must present the key this phone paired with before anything is sent to it.
Nothing on this network announced this desktop.
PAL needs Android’s local network permission to search.
This phone cannot search the network now.
%1$s did not present this desktop’s key, so it was not added. If you renewed the gateway with a new key, pair again.
%1$s was added. PAL tries it with the paired addresses.
This phone already keeps five addresses for this desktop. Remove one first.

Optional, for when background monitoring is off. A push app you choose (UnifiedPush) tells this phone to connect when something waits. The message is empty and encrypted to this phone; requests are still reviewed here and signed as always.
No push app is installed. Install one that supports UnifiedPush, such as ntfy, then come back.
Connect to the desktop to turn this on.
Update PAL on the desktop to use wake-ups.

It was declined or the push server no longer knows this phone. Try again to ask once more.

The push app needs you to open it first.
